# ankra_dns_credentials (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's DNS webhook credentials; the webhook URLs are never returned. The counterpart of `ankra org dns credentials list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_dns_credentials" "all" {}

output "dns_credential_names" {
  value = data.ankra_dns_credentials.all.credentials[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) DNS credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the credential was stored.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
